description: The secret masker of the approval card and the request (maskSecrets in lib/permissions.mjs): each rule of TOKEN_PATTERNS, the name of a secret (prefix, endings, quotes), what a bare value may be and the registered secrets, judged by tests/verify-mask-secrets.mjs (33+ spellings of a secret that must go, 26 lines that only mention secrets and must stay, the old pins and nine awkward layouts for time).

mutations.name: MS-prefix-none
mutations.what: a secret name has no prefix (DB_PASSWORD)

mutations.name: MS-prefix-long
mutations.what: the prefix of a secret name may be any length
mutations.equivalent: only the time differs, and the layouts of the time check are built so that a long prefix would show

mutations.name: MS-suffix-none
mutations.what: a secret name has no ending (SECRET_KEY)

mutations.name: MS-suffix-wide
mutations.what: a secret name may end in anything (tokenCount)

mutations.name: MS-bracket
mutations.what: the name of a secret in square brackets is not seen

mutations.name: MS-words-token
mutations.what: token is not a secret word

mutations.name: MS-words-secret
mutations.what: secret is not a secret word

mutations.name: MS-call
mutations.what: a call is taken for a value

mutations.name: MS-number
mutations.what: a number is taken for a secret

mutations.name: MS-slash
mutations.what: a regular expression is taken for a secret

mutations.name: MS-bare-quote
mutations.what: a bare value may start with a quote
mutations.equivalent: the characters of a bare value exclude the quotes, so it could not start with one anyway

mutations.name: MS-bare-short
mutations.what: a bare value of one character is a secret

mutations.name: MS-quoted-short
mutations.what: a quoted value of one character is a secret

mutations.name: MS-quoted-newline
mutations.what: a quoted value may run over several lines

mutations.name: MS-quoted-case
mutations.what: the rule for a quoted value is case sensitive

mutations.name: MS-bare-case
mutations.what: the rule for a bare value is case sensitive

mutations.name: MS-authorization-twice
mutations.what: the authorization rule masks what the bearer rule has masked

mutations.name: MS-bearer-short
mutations.what: any word after bearer is a secret

mutations.name: MS-registered-short
mutations.what: a registered value of one character is masked

mutations.name: MS-registered-off
mutations.what: registered secrets are not masked
